name: Membrane visual assets
generated: Edit scripts/render-visual-assets.mjs, then run npm run render:visuals. Colors resolve from semantic tokens.

assets.title: Passage
assets.description: An open organic trace meets a dotted boundary and continues as three aligned routes.
assets.usage: Website openings, editorial covers and section introductions about interpretation or translation.
assets.limitations: An expressive motif, not a measured process. Keep labels outside the artwork; preserve the crossing when cropping.

assets.title: Confluence
assets.description: Three independent curved paths gather at an open ring, then separate into a structured set of routes.
assets.usage: Presentation covers and introductions to collective inquiry or synthesis.
assets.limitations: Do not imply that different perspectives become equivalent. Use a labelled diagram for an actual method.

assets.title: Field notes
assets.description: A loose warm plane sits behind a precise open frame, with a curved observation trace and annotation anchors.
assets.usage: Teaching cards, editorial sidebars and introductory illustrations about observation.
assets.limitations: Anchors are decorative until connected to visible HTML labels. Never substitute this motif for actual evidence.

assets.title: Learning loop
assets.description: An unfinished organic loop and an open rectangular route share two meeting points, leaving room for revision.
assets.usage: Reflection prompts, iteration stories and workshop material.
assets.limitations: The open loop suggests revisiting an idea; it does not encode a universal learning model or a progress value.

assets.title: Permeable grid
assets.description: An open dotted grid interrupted by three organic crossings, with generous blank intervals.
assets.usage: Cropped margins, section transitions and separate supporting fields.
assets.limitations: Decorative texture only. Keep text on its own solid surface and never treat dot counts as data.

assets.title: Trace field
assets.description: A family of independent warm curves becomes spaced, straight teal traces across an open seam.
assets.usage: Wide editorial strips, cover margins and transitions between sections.
assets.limitations: Decorative line field, not a chart, frequency scale or representation of recorded signals.
